name: g1_amendment_ratification
purpose: W2's ratification of prereg amendment 2 (issue #37): can the proposed G1 both pass and fail, for the right reasons?

uniform_loss.why: every gene loses 30%; tier A is not lost more than its abundance peers, so the project's premise is unsupported and PASS would be wrong

broad_loss_tier_d_retained.why: the world the project claims — broad loss, tier A hardest, MS4A12 maintained against it. A gate that cannot pass here is as useless as one that cannot fail

isolated_tier_a_loss.why: tier A gone and NOTHING else moves. Also a true signal, and the gate is a coin flip on it — see AMENDMENT_2_POWER_CAVEAT

pure_soup.why: loss is a function of abundance and nothing else — the ambient artefact G1 exists to catch

tiers_drift_together.why: config/panel.yaml's falsification rule: if the tiers return the same answer, no biological claim may be made

caveat: Threshold 2's power depends on a broad loss background for the retained control to stand out against. P(PASS)=0.517 on isolated_tier_a_loss, a world where the project's claim is true.
not_a_g1_result: Simulation only. src/reference/checks.py returns not_estimable until the team ratifies.
